dxf_upload_region_rule: exact canonical filename stem equals server region id
online_rendering: persistent fiber cache + cache-first viewport + instant layer hide/show restore
map_labels: device IDs/pole numbers/address text hidden; details on selection only
line_color_policy: preserve CAD display_color/true_color; fallback distinguishes fiber/coax/cell-boundary/connection lines
device_rendering: dedupe same-kind nearby device points by spatial key; filter text/info payloads before device rendering
zoom_rendering: zoom_changed only toggles in-memory overlay visibility; no API reload
cache_policy: render stale/valid cache immediately; refresh stale bbox in background; replace only after successful fetch/save; then rerender
upload_session_policy: no fixed Windows client timeout; heartbeat every 15s; pause local idle guard during upload
fiber_cache_policy: same revision is a hit only when cached fiber count matches server object_count
coax_device_policy: preserve explicit legacy device POINTs and keep device symbols above cables
device_filter_policy: TEXT/MTEXT/ATTRIB/ID/address/info entities are never rendered as devices
fiber_device_policy: FIBER Point devices are created from persistent fiber cache and shown only at detailed zoom levels
server_upload_proxy_policy: apply server-tools/apply_long_upload_timeout_v1.sh to set nginx request/proxy timeouts to 86400s
upload_progress_policy: exact transmitted bytes / total JSON bytes percentage; after 100%, show server DB save/validation phase
fiber_geometry_policy: preserve every CAD line/polyline/polygon primitive; use MultiLineString for multipart entities
annotation_policy: -Anno/ANNO registration and annotation objects are excluded from upload and rendering for fiber/coax
amplifier_direction_policy: coax polyline last point touching amplifier = input; arrow points into amplifier; amplifier orientation is opposite input / signal-output direction; ambiguous input shows no arrow
